metadata.question: Does the vegetation coverage in the Inner Niger Delta increase in November 2022 compared to May 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) median composites for May 2022 and Nov 2022 over an explicit polygon approximating the Inner Niger Delta. If no images, fall back to Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 merged collection.
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds/cirrus (S2 QA60) and cloud/shadow/snow (Landsat QA_PIXEL). Do not mask water or soil; compute NDVI and count pixels with NDVI > 0.3 as vegetation coverage.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Check collection size; if 0 after fallback => C1. Compute valid pixel count with Reducer.count; if 0 => C2. Check for null/NaN or percent outside 0–100 => C3. Otherwise compare Nov% > May%.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfo(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo(resolve, reject);
    });
  }
  const scale = 1000;
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[-6.0,16.3],[-6.0,13.2],[-3.4,13.2],[-3.4,16.3],[-6.0,16.3]]], null, false);
  const ndviThresh = 0.3;

  function maskS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
    const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function prepLandsatL2(img) {
    // Scale reflectance and mask clouds/shadows/snow
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloudShadowBit = 1 << 4;
    const cloudBit = 1 << 3;
    const dilatedBit = 1 << 1;
    const snowBit = 1 << 5;
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBit).eq(0)
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(dilatedBit).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(snowBit).eq(0));
    const bands = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(bands, null, true).updateMask(mask);
  }

  async function statsForPeriod(start, end, label) {
    try {
      // Sentinel-2 attempt
      let s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
        .map(maskS2);
      const s2Count = await getInfo(s2.size());
      if (s2Count > 0) {
        const s2Med = s2.median();
        const ndvi = s2Med.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).rename('ndvi');
        const total = await getInfo(ndvi.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('ndvi'));
        const veg = ndvi.gt(ndviThresh).rename('veg');
        const vegPx = await getInfo(veg.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('veg'));
        return {label, source: 'S2', imgCount: s2Count, total, vegPx};
      }
      // Fallback Landsat 8/9
      let l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).map(prepLandsatL2);
      let l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).map(prepLandsatL2);
      let ls = l8.merge(l9);
      const lsCount = await getInfo(ls.size());
      if (lsCount > 0) {
        const lsMed = ls.median();
        const ndvi = lsMed.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('ndvi');
        const total = await getInfo(ndvi.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('ndvi'));
        const veg = ndvi.gt(ndviThresh).rename('veg');
        const vegPx = await getInfo(veg.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('veg'));
        return {label, source: 'Landsat89', imgCount: lsCount, total, vegPx};
      }
      // No images in both S2 and Landsat
      return {label, status: 'C1'};
    } catch (e) {
      return {label, status: 'D', error: String(e)};
    }
  }

  const may = await statsForPeriod('2022-05-01', '2022-05-31', 'May 2022');
  const nov = await statsForPeriod('2022-11-01', '2022-11-30', 'Nov 2022');

  // Print concise evidence
  console.log(`Region: Inner Niger Delta (approx), Scale: ${scale} m`);
  console.log(`NDVI threshold for vegetation: > ${ndviThresh}`);
  if (may.status === 'D' || nov.status === 'D') {
    if (may.status === 'D') console.log(`Error (${may.label}): ${may.error}`);
    if (nov.status === 'D') console.log(`Error (${nov.label}): ${nov.error}`);
    console.log('D');
    return;
  }
  if (may.status === 'C1' || nov.status === 'C1') {
    console.log(`${may.label} Images: ${may.imgCount || 0} (source: ${may.source || 'None'})`);
    console.log(`${nov.label} Images: ${nov.imgCount || 0} (source: ${nov.source || 'None'})`);
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  // Validate pixel counts
  const mayTotal = may.total || 0;
  const mayVeg = may.vegPx || 0;
  const novTotal = nov.total || 0;
  const novVeg = nov.vegPx || 0;

  if (mayTotal === 0 || novTotal === 0) {
    console.log(`${may.label}: imgs=${may.imgCount}, valid_px=${mayTotal}, veg_px=${mayVeg}`);
    console.log(`${nov.label}: imgs=${nov.imgCount}, valid_px=${novTotal}, veg_px=${novVeg}`);
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  // Compute percentages
  const mayPct = (mayVeg / mayTotal) * 100.0;
  const novPct = (novVeg / novTotal) * 100.0;

  // Validate results
  const invalid = [mayPct, novPct].some(v => v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v) || v < 0 || v > 100);
  if (invalid) {
    console.log(`${may.label}: imgs=${may.imgCount}, valid_px=${mayTotal}, veg_px=${mayVeg}, veg%=${mayPct}`);
    console.log(`${nov.label}: imgs=${nov.imgCount}, valid_px=${novTotal}, veg_px=${novVeg}, veg%=${novPct}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  console.log(`${may.label}: source=${may.source}, images=${may.imgCount}, valid_px=${mayTotal}, veg_px=${mayVeg}, veg%=${mayPct.toFixed(2)}`);
  console.log(`${nov.label}: source=${nov.source}, images=${nov.imgCount}, valid_px=${novTotal}, veg_px=${novVeg}, veg%=${novPct.toFixed(2)}`);

  // Final answer
  if (novPct > mayPct) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
